notes: File sync from Z.ai now works when the website's viewer consumed the code fences: v1.0.34 parses the FILE: blocks from the reply text the app already captured for the turn (fences or no fences, plain pasted content, language labels, CRLF, Bengali prose around the blocks), and the site-side lookup walks the website's own message chain with tolerant response shapes and timestamps. The final report card turns AMBER with "Files not synced" and a Sync button whenever Z.ai claimed files but none reached the project - never a green "Task finished". Synced files are verified by reading them back from disk (path + byte count) with Open buttons. Project tabs are identical for Z.ai and Antigravity (Chat / Files / Terminal / Preview): a synced index.html gets an "Open preview" button that serves the project folder on localhost, and RUN-loop commands appear in the project Terminal marked [Z.ai]. Everything from v1.0.33 (conflict choices, keep-both, undo, the no-progress timeout with Re-read / Sync files now, the manual "Sync files from Z.ai" button) works the same. Nothing new runs at startup.
